cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll need to tell the team why we've cut the outing. You approved the figures with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I drew a line through that total to reject it. You copied my line and signed underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, the revised figure. You can explain the change; you marked it first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll show them the spreadsheet, but you have to explain your signature.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Open with why you rejected it. Once you've told them there's no outing, I'll explain the signature.
